column2: AN ACT TO INCORPORATE THE INSTITUTE OF WORLD LIFE LINE
YOGA
WHERE  an  Institute called and known as the “Institute of
World  Life  Line  Yoga”  has  heretofore  been  formed  in
Sri Lanka  for  the  purpose  of  effectually  carrying  out  and
transacting  all  objects  and  matters  connected  with  the  said
Institute according to the rules agreed to by its members:
AND  WHEREAS  the  said  Institute  has  heretofore
successfully  carried  out  and  transacted  the  objects  and
matters    for  which  it  was  formed  and  has  applied  to  be
incorporated and it will be for the public advantage to grant
such  application:
BE it therefore enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic
Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:—

1.
This Act may be cited as the Institute of World Life
Line Yoga (Incorporation) Act, No.       2021.

2.
From  and  after  the  date  of  commencement  of  this
Act,  such  and  so  may  persons  as  now  are  members  of
the “Institute of World Life Line Yoga” (hereinafter referred
to  as  the  “Foundation”)  or  shall  hereafter  be  admitted  as
members shall be a body corporate (hereinafter referred to as
the “Corporation”) with perpetual succession under the name
and style of the “Institute of World Life Line Yoga” and by
that name may sue and be sued in all courts, with full power
and authority to have and use a common seal and alter the
same at its pleasure.
